question: Of the following sets, the one that includes all values of \(x\) which will satisfy \(2x-3\gt7-x\) is:
solution:
Add \(x+3\) to both sides to collect the variable terms on the left and the constants on the right:
\[
2x-3>7-x
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
3x>10.
\]
Dividing by the positive number \(3\) preserves the inequality's direction, giving
\[
\boxed{x>\frac{10}{3}}.
\]
All the steps are reversible, so this describes every solution. The endpoint \(10/3\) is excluded because the original inequality is strict. The answer is \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
